name: sec_filing_search
description: Search and retrieve SEC EDGAR filings for a publicly traded US company. Use this tool when you need official regulatory disclosures including annual reports (10-K), quarterly reports (10-Q), material event reports (8-K), or proxy statements (DEF 14A). Returns filing text and metadata.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, TSLA)

filing_type.description: Type of SEC filing to retrieve

year.description: Filing year (defaults to most recent if omitted)
